/bin/zsh -lc "set -o pipefail
WEB=http://127.0.0.1:49515
COOKIE=docs/acceptance/insight-test-instance-20260831/raw/session.cookie
{
  echo '# deployed-smoke on installed launchd test-instance'
  echo 'binary=./bin/agent-center'
  echo 'instance=insight-smoke-20260831'
  echo 'web='"'$WEB
  echo '"'## bootstrap'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/auth/bootstrap"
  echo '"'\\n## me'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/auth/me"
  echo '"'\\n## projects list'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/projects"
  echo '"'\\n## seeded project detail'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/projects/project-0f187407"
  echo '"'\\n## channels list'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/channels"
  echo '"'\\n## seeded channel detail'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/channels/channel-9af573ea"
  echo '"'\\n## fleet'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" "$WEB/api/fleet"
  echo '"'\\n## files create upload'
  create="'$(curl -sS -b "$COOKIE" -H '"'content-type: application/json' -X POST \""'$WEB/api/files" -d '"'{\"content_type\":\"text/plain\",\"size\":19}')
  echo \""'$create"
  transfer=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$create" | sed -n '"'s/.*\"transfer_id\":\"\\(["'^"]*'"\\)\".*/\\1/p')
  echo \"transfer_id="'$transfer"
  echo '"'\\n## files put bytes'
  printf 'insight smoke bytes' > docs/acceptance/insight-test-instance-20260831/raw/upload-payload.txt
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" -X PUT "$WEB/api/files/transfer/$transfer" --data-binary @docs/acceptance/insight-test-instance-20260831/raw/upload-payload.txt
  echo '"'\\n## files complete'
  curl -i -sS -b \""'$COOKIE" -H '"'content-type: application/json' -X POST \""'$WEB/api/files/transfer/$transfer/complete" -d '"'{\"size\":19}'
} > docs/acceptance/insight-test-instance-20260831/raw/08-deployed-smoke.log 2>&1; code="'$?; echo deployed_smoke_exit=$code | tee -a docs/acceptance/insight-test-instance-20260831/raw/08-deployed-smoke.log; exit $code'
